A tsunami crosses an ocean at the speed of a jet and rises into a wall of water near shore. Here is the science.

#shorts #science #tsunami #ocean #nature

sahneler.metin: A tsunami is not a normal wave - it is a moving wall of ocean.
It usually begins with an earthquake deep under the sea.
The seafloor jerks upward and shoves a huge volume of water.
In deep water the wave is low but races at jet speed.
You would not even feel it pass beneath a boat.
But as it reaches shallow water near the coast, it slows.
All that energy piles up into a towering wall of water.
The sea often pulls back first, exposing the seabed.
If the water suddenly retreats, run for high ground.
